===[[The Black Raven#Fighting the Black Raven|'''Fighting the Black Raven''']]===
* {{Winning|surrender=true|"I see the rumorsss are true. I yield, we are no match for you. Take this and let us leave in ssshame."}}
*# Accept his surrender. &nbsp;<span style="color:grey;">(the weapon and the scrap amount are shown prior to accepting or rejecting the offer)</span>
*#* ''He transfers over the goods and starts to repair his ship.''
*#** You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">weapon</span> with high <span style="color:#70b8ff">scrap</span>.
*# Ignore him and attack.
*#* ''"Wait! There is no need to be...." You cut off the transmission and prepare to fire.''
*#** Continue the fight.
* {{Winning|destroyed=true|"The Black Raven" breaks apart and you salvage the remains.}}
** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
* {{Winning|deadCrew=true|The once-dreaded pirate Nights has been killed and you proceed to loot his ship.}}
** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "DONOR_BLACK_RAVEN" in the datafiles.
* Enemy ship:
** Captain Nights' cruiser, the ''Black Raven'', is always a Slug Assault class.
** This is the only event where you fight a Slug Assault in sector 4, as normally they cannot appear until sector 5.
** The {{tooltip|ship|DONOR_BLACK_RAVEN}} proposes a surrender offer when its hull integrity falls down to {{tooltip|30-40%|or 3-4 hull adjusted by the sector number [needs thorough verification]}}.
* This is a donor event.
* This event is a reference to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Princess_Bride_(film) The Princess Bride].
